description: SEC filings for `ticker` available on `as_of_date`, newest first, with amendment linkage.

as_of_date.description: Knowledge date, YYYY-MM-DD. Only filings that were already public on that date are returned, newest first, with amendment linkage (amends_accession).

form_type.description: Exact SEC form type, for example 10-K, 10-Q, 10-Q/A, or 8-K. If omitted the list can be very large. Prefer passing a type.

ticker.description: Issuer ticker as used by PtData, for example AAPL.

name: get_filing_metadata
title: Get filing metadata
